blocks.text: SCHEDULE: Gilas Pilipinas women at Asian Games 2026 5×5 basketball MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas blew out Kazakhstan, 86-58, on Thursday for a blazing start to its campaign in the women’s basketball 5-on-5 competitions of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. Naturalized player Beth Means fired 23 points on 9-of-17 shooting to lead Gilas to a lopsided victory in the contest held at Aichi International Arena. Means also had four rebounds and eight steals in her first national team appearance since securing her citizenship. Stefanie Berberabe also came through for Gilas with 11 points, four rebounds, eight assists and five steals. Coach BT Toews’ […]...
